instruction: From the video file src.mp4 on the Desktop, create an animated GIF file named desktop_clip.gif using VLC and GIMP. The GIF should contain frames from a 5-second clip starting at 00:03.

metadata.explanation: Task generates an animated GIF from a 5-second video segment beginning at 3-second mark. Steps: 1) Open src.mp4 in VLC, 2) Navigate to 3-second position, 3) Extract 5-second clip, 4) Load frames in GIMP, 5) Export as desktop_clip.gif. Evaluator checks file exists, GIF format, and has at least 10 frames.

scoring_breakdown.0.5: GIF file exists at specified location

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete verification coverage: Instruction requires '5-second clip starting at 00:03' but evaluator does not verify clip duration or starting position
Frame count threshold too low: min_frames=10 is insufficient to verify 5 seconds of content (typical GIF frame rates would require 25-150 frames for 5 seconds)
Cannot distinguish correct clip from incorrect clip: Evaluator would pass for any animated GIF with 10+ frames, regardless of whether it contains the correct 5-second segment from 00:03
No source video verification: Does not verify that GIF was created from src.mp4 vs other sources
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Increase min_frames threshold to 25-50 to better represent 5 seconds of animation
Add duration verification if technically feasible (check GIF metadata for total duration ~5 seconds)
Consider simplifying instruction to remove timing requirements if they cannot be verified, or add metadata/visual verification
Current evaluator can only verify: file exists, is GIF format, and is animated - consider aligning instruction to match verifiable properties
